snippet.title: Misty and the Last Breeze | Official Trailer | 3D Platformer With a Skateboard
snippet.description:
Platform it, then skate it.

Misty and the Last Breeze is a bright, fast 3D platformer with a skateboard. Run, wall-run and vine-swing through hand-built stages, then call your air board mid-run to grind vines, ride waterfalls and kickflip across canyons. Chain it all into one fast line and chase the gold time.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5339000/Misty_and_the_Last_Breeze/

MOVE LIKE THE WIND
- Triple jumps, long jumps, backflips, ground pounds and an air dash
- Wall runs, wall jumps, ledge grabs and vine swings
- Throw a gust of wind, then leap off it to reach what you shouldn't

GRAB YOUR BOARD
- Grind rails, vines and branches
- Ride stone flumes and canyon half pipes
- String kickflips, heelflips, grabs and spins into one combo

WORLDS INSIDE PAINTINGS
An abandoned castle hangs paintings that still hold the wind. Step through one and land in its world: toy-box isles in the sky, a jungle canopy, a sun-scoured mesa and more.

Short 2 to 3 minute stages, medal times to chase and strawberries hidden on the riskiest lines.

Coming to Steam in 2027.
Developed by Ilia Reingold.

#MistyAndTheLastBreeze #3DPlatformer #IndieGame
